caption:
Koko's stiff back is making it hard to cuddle the grandkids, and she's nervous about her first chiro visit.

It starts with a conversation: your health, medications, past injuries, bone health and what you want to keep doing. Care for older adults often uses gentle options like low-force mobilisation or soft tissue work, chosen after assessment, and you can say no to anything.

Expect simple strength, balance and mobility exercises for home. If you have osteoporosis, your chiropractor will adapt their approach and may liaise with your GP. New back pain after a fall or leg numbness means a GP visit first.

Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio take time to assess you. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
